import hashlib, json, re
from html.parser import HTMLParser
from pathlib import Path
from urllib.parse import parse_qs, urlsplit

class InquiryLinks(HTMLParser):
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        self.links = []

    def handle_starttag(self, tag, attrs):
        href = dict(attrs).get('href') or ''
        if tag != 'a' or not href.lower().startswith('mailto:'):
            return
        target = urlsplit(href)
        fields = parse_qs(target.query)
        subject = ' '.join(fields.get('subject', []))
        body = '\n'.join(fields.get('body', []))
        self.links.append({'recipient_present': bool(target.path), 'subject_prefilled': bool(subject), 'body_prefilled': bool(body), 'subject_identifiers': sorted(set(re.findall(r'site:[a-z0-9-]+', subject))), 'body_identifiers': sorted(set(re.findall(r'site:[a-z0-9-]+', body)))})

snapshot = Path('products/distribution/catalogue-referral/2026-11-18-live-destination.html')
draft = Path('products/services/catalogue-agency-prospects/distribution-handoff/aligned/final-message.md')
output = Path('products/distribution/catalogue-referral/live-pilot-link-check.json')

def sha(path):
    return hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()

snapshot_sha = sha(snapshot)
assert snapshot_sha == '8bb6898a489669b02cd4db20f10abbe524a2d87b4c4590d233b49d337eb83bcc', 'Snapshot does not match the observed fetch receipt'
parser = InquiryLinks()
parser.feed(snapshot.read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
draft_sha = sha(draft)

Release matching, draft wording, intake allowlisting, mail-client behavior, actual attribution and delivery require separate evidence.'}

output.write_text(json.dumps(result, indent=2) + '\n', encoding='utf-8')
print(output.read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
